Commentary.Commentary: A pulsating batting performance from the Aussies. Warner set the tone with the second fastest fifty in Test history early on. Smith and Khawaja too rattled up brisk fifties while Handscomb played a flier of a cameo to propel the lead past the 460-run mark. The innings run rate was a staggering 7.53! Absolute carnage! Pakistan's bowlers were dismantled, they had given up before the innings started. Tricky phase to negotiate to stumps today for the tourists as it's a bit overcast too which will aid the seamers. The chase isn't far away.

That is it. Steven Smith is trying to get the attention of his batsmen who simply aren't looking at the balcony. A bit similar to what happened to Sourav Ganguly when India declared against Australia in Kolkata in 2001. Zaheer Khan was just not looking at the balcony! Anyways, the news is that AUSTRALIA HAVE DECLARED. They have 16 overs tonight, weather permitting and another 98 tomorrow, depending on Mother Nature's mood. THE TARGET IS 465.
Comes down the track, but Ali fires it miles outside off and Handscomb has to go back.
LEADING EDGE, BUT SAFE. Full on middle and leg, it is a wrong 'un, Khawaja does not pick it as he looks to flick and gets a leading edge which does not carry to cover. A single taken.
This is pitched a meter outside leg stump, PH comes down the track and drives it beautifully down to long on for a run.
Outside off, chopped down to short third man for a single.
Full outside off, actually it is converted into a full toss by Peter who jumps out  and drives it to deepish mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, eased down to long off for a single. Handscomb comes halfway down the track for the second but is sent back.
FOUR! What a shot. Fractionally short in length outside off, Handscomb goes back and cuts it behind point for a boundary.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full on middle, Khawaja comes down the track and drives it down to long on but Yasir Shah dives to his left to stop.
Full again, another sweep played, this is behind square leg for a single.
FOUR! TONK! This is outside off, Handscomb gets down and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary. THE LEAD CROSSES 450. Declaration might be around the corner.
Full and outside off, Handscomb comes down the track and lofts it over covers for a couple.
FOUR! Cheeky from Khawaja! Flatter on leg stump, Khawaja sits back to that one and glances it down to fine leg for a boundary. Nicely done. Lead is now 447.
Floated outside off, very full and Handscomb makes room to squeeze it to point for a single.
Loopy on the pads, gets across and works it away on the leg side for a run.
Flatter on the pads, worked away on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Floated on middle, steps out to that one and heaves it away over mid-wicket. Clean strike and it speeds away to the fence for a boundary.
Drags it short on middle, Khawaja gets back and pulls it down to long leg for a single.
Floated on leg stump, Handscomb makes room and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated outside off, stays back and jabs it to third man for a single.
Fuller on middle, worked to mid-wicket.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Tossed up outside off, steps out to that one and heaves it away over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Nicely struck that and it sailed way over the ropes.
Fuller on middle, leans into it and drills it to long on for a single.

FOUR! CHANCE MISSED! Floated well outside leg, Handscomb steps out to flick but overbalances a bit. Gets it off the toe end just past the keeper to fine leg for a boundary. It was a half-chance although it was very, very tough.
Fuller outside off, Handscomb steps out and makes room to blast it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller on middle, Khawaja flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Flatter on middle, gets back to flick but is struck on the pads. They sneak a leg bye.
Flatter on leg stump, Handscomb backs away and cuts it towards backward point where Shafiq makes a diving half-stop. The ball trickles to the deep as the batsmen get a brace.
Floated on a length outside off, makes a lot of room and carves it over the covers for a brace.
On a length outside off, steps out and pushes it towards cover.
Loopy outside off, steps out and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Full outside off, gets across to sweep but is hit on the pads.
Drifting on to the pads, gets back and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Low full toss on middle, worked away to deep square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Flatter on middle, Khawaja gets back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace as Imran Khan does well to adjust after he overran the ball initially. Brace added.
Full and outside off, reaches out and drives it to long off for a single.
Flighted on middle, steps out and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, leans into it and taps gently towards cover.
Drops it short outside off, cut away through point for a brace.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT TO PLAY FIRST BALL! Shot of a man in supreme form. Floated on middle, Handscomb charges down the track and lofts it cleanly over wide mid on for a boundary. Made terrific contact there.
Floated outside off, Khawaja gets across and glances it down to fine leg. Doesn't make the fence, they get three more. LEAD GOES PAST 400.
AZHAR ALI is back on.
PETER HANDSCOMB is the new man in.

OUT! YES HE HAS! Good review from Pakistan and the Australian captain has to go. This was drifting down the leg side and Smith went for the sweep as Sarfraz collected it. The keeper felt there was some noise and asks Misbah to go for the review after the caught behind appeal was denied. Replays show a slight spike on the Snickometer as the ball passes the glove. There's a tiny mark on the Hot Spot as well. So, the on-field call is overturned and Smith has to go.
Pakistan have taken a review for caught behind against Smith. Was there any glove there?
Fuller on middle and leg, goes across to sweep but misses.
Fuller and on the pads, swept away on the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Floated around leg stump, spins down the leg side as Khawaja misses the flick. He loses balance and then has to reach back as Sarfraz reacts slowly to whip off the bails. They check the stumping appeal upstairs but the southpaw is safe. Sarfraz should have been sharper there.
Stumping appeal against Khawaja being referred. Touch and go stuff but he's probably just in as Sarfraz was late to react.
Slightly short on off, Khawaja makes room and punches it to cover.
Tossed up outside off, steps out to that one and pushes it to cover.
Back of a length outside off, cut to point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Blasted away! Low full toss outside off, Smith leans into it and pummels the drive through extra cover to find the fence once more. The Aussie captain is on the rampage.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Slower bouncer but Smith has picked it early. Swivels to nail the pull through backward square leg to find the fence.
Dug in short outside off, pulled hard to deep mid-wicket for a single.
20th Test fifty for Smith.
Fuller on middle, Smith gets across to that one and clips it through mid-wicket for a single. Fine knock from the skipper in his 50th Test.
Floated outside off, gets across to play the reverse sweep. A bit aerial but just short of backward point.
8th Test fifty for Khawaja.

FOUR! KABOOM! Khawaja also joins in the fun. Declaration charge well and truly on. Floated outside off, he gets across on one knee and slog sweeps it cleanly over mid-wicket. Finds the fence once more. Lead is 384 now.
FOUR! Slammed! Floated outside off, steps out to that one and heaves it away over mid on. Flies to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Cut away! Poor ball from Yasir, short and wide, Smith rocks back and nails the cut through point for a boundary. This has been a quickfire knock from the captain, more in his limited-overs mode according to the situation.
Floated outside off, worked past square leg for a single.
YASIR SHAH comes back on.
FOUR! Slapped! Slower ball outside off, Smith waits for it and cuts it away through point as the ball rockets to the fence for a boundary. Played it late and found the gap with precision.
Fuller on middle, gets across and pats it towards mid on.
FOUR! More aggression from Smith! Full and around off, he goes for the heave over wide mid on. Got it off the bottom half but still cleared the fielder comfortably to find the fence. Lead is now 366.
Length ball outside off, width on offer and Khawaja creams it to sweeper cover for a run.
Fuller on middle, Smith shuffles and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish around off, pulled away to deep square leg for a single. Wasn't timed that well.
IMRAN KHAN is back on.
Spears it well down the leg side, no stroke offered.
Short of a length on off, swivels and pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Dug in short around off, Khawaja sways away from the line.
Good length on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Incredible shot! Back of a length on middle, Smith winds up for the heave over mid-wicket initially but is cramped for room. However, he has such quick hands and propels it fine down the leg side to the fence for a boundary using his strong wrists.
Fuller on the pads, gets across and glances it down to fine leg for a single.
Floated on off, gets across and paddles it very deftly down towards fine leg. Three more runs added to the total.
Flighted on middle, steps out to that one and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover. They go for the second run and Smith has to really stretch himself as Sarfraz whips off the bails. The appeal is referred upstairs but the Aussie skipper is safe.
Run out appeal referred upstairs. Smith is the man in question, he seems okay to the naked eye.
Flighted outside off, Smith gets across to play the paddle sweep but gets a top edge over the keeper down the leg side. Younis from first slip gives chase as the batsmen get a brace.
On a length outside off, Smith shapes for the cut but the length isn't there for it and gets beaten.
Floated on a length outside off, gets back and jabs it towards point. Single taken. 50-run stand comes up with the run.
YASIR SHAH to bowl from the other end.
Length ball outside off, Smith goes for the booming drive but gets a thick inside edge on to the boot.
What happened there? Slow cutter at 127.6 kph on back of a length on leg stump, grips a bit off the surface as Smith shuffles to flick. He misses and the ball just goes over leg stump to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, Khawaja stands tall and punches it sweetly through the covers. Three more to the total.
Shortish around off, Khawaja looks to pull but mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Khawaja leans into it and defends it well.
Good length outside off, leans forward and blocks it to the covers.

Welcome back. The players are back on the field. How many more will Smith want before he declares? I reckon an hour's batting might be his target as that could get the lead somewhere between 400-425. WAHAB RIAZ to start proceedings after tea.
...DAY 4, SESSION 3...

Yet another session to Australia. The hosts took an hour to wrap up the final two wickets before deciding not to enforce the follow on. Then, Warner led a blitzkrieg which allowed the Aussies to go into the break at an innings run rate of 6.5! Lead is now 340 and the home side will look to bat an hour after tea probably with an aim of getting about 10 overs at Pakistan today. Join us in a while for the final session.

SIX! SLAMMED! Terrific shot! Floated outside off, in the arc for Smith to launch the slog sweep way over deep mid-wicket for a mammoth maximum. The lead has swelled to 340 in almost no time. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 4.
Loopy on middle and leg, Khawaja gets back to flick but it goes off the pads down the leg side. They get a single.
Flatter outside off, stays back and blocks well.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it down to long off for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked off the back foot through backward square leg for a brace.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Creamed! Floated outside off, too full and Khawaja drills it through the covers. Slammed it well as the ball rockets to the fence.
Full and outside off, leans forward to block but is struck on the pads. Lbw appeal, turned down.
A bit short outside off, Khawaja gose for the late cut. On the bounce to first slip where Younis makes a fine stop to his left.
Floated on a length outside off, hangs back and defends it to short leg.
On a length outside off, stays back and taps it with the turn to short leg.
Drifting on to the pads, worked off the back foot down to fine leg for a single.
AZHAR ALI comes on to bowl.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards the silly mid off region as Yasir dives to his left to make the stop.
FOUR! Hammered! Smith's now flowing smoothly. Half-tracker from Yasir and gets the treatment. Pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary. Lead is now 324.
Floated outside off, stays back and jabs it to point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Drifting on middle, Smith steps out to that one and whips it away through mid on. Almost similar to Dhoni's helicopter stroke as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Floated outside off, goes across and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Drops it short outside off, Smith stays back and punches it past cover-point for a brace.
Shortish outside off, sits back and defends well.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly to mid off.
Another bumper, too high this time and wide called as Khawaja ducks.
Dug in short around off, Khawaja ducks under it.
Back of a length on middle, gets across and tucks it to deep backward square leg for a brace.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja hangs back and defends well.
Good length closer to off, Khawaja stays in the crease and blocks well.
Another half-tracker outside off, stays back and cuts but straight to point once more.

STUMPING MISSED! Not the first time Sarfraz has messed such an opportunity. Floated wider outside off, very full and Khawaja was down the track but failed to make contact. There was extra bounce although that cannot be an excuse for Sarfraz who misses it completely. Three byes to the total as the ball goes to third man.
Floated on middle, stays back and bunts it to mid on for a single.
Slightly short outside off, Smith cannot find the gap at point with his cut shot.
Floated outside off, steps out to that one and pushes it towards cover.
On a length outside off, stays back and pushes it to the off side. It goes off the outer half as the batsmen take a single.

OUCH! That will hurt. Back of a length around off, Smith swivels for the pull but the ball doesn't quite rise as much as he expected. Rams him in the stomach and the Aussie captain winces a bit. Breaks into smiles soon and so that's nice to see. Wahab walks up to him and gives him a pat on his back as well.
Shortish on middle, gets across and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Khawaja hangs back and blocks.
Length ball angled in from around off, defended firmly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, Khawaja reaches out and blocks.
Length ball on middle, Smith shuffles across and clips it away for a single. Deep square leg moves slightly to his left to tidy up.
Drifting in from around off, blocked firmly from the crease.
Floated outside off, Khawaja gets across and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Flighted on off, Khawaja uses his feet and lifts it down the ground. Didn't quite time it but cleared mid off comfortably. A couple more to the total.
On a length outside off, Usman stays back and defends with an angled bat.
Flighted outside off, presses forward and blocks solidly.
Floated on off, worked gently towards mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, Smith gets forward and defends firmly.
Banged in short around off, Khawaja shuffles a bit and controls the pull down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, Khawaja rises on his toes and steers it towards gully.
Back of a length wider outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Dug in short and Khawaja ducks under the bumper.
Back of a length on off, gets across and taps it to the right of mid on for a sharp single.
Flatter on middle, pushed off the back foot to mid on for a single.
A touch short outside off, Smith cuts but cannot find the gap at cover.
Flatter on a length around off, Khawaja gets across on one knee and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly but straight to short cover.
Tossed up outside off, presses forward and blocks it.
Floated on middle, Khawaja nudges it with the turn towards square leg.
Shortish outside off, nicely defended off the back foot.
Back of a length angling across Smith who is beaten on the poke off the back foot. It kept a bit low as well.
STEVEN SMITH is the new man in.

OUT! GOT HIM! Relief on the faces of all the Pakistani players. Wahab gets Warner for the second time in the match. Length ball on middle, Warner was backing away a lot and had a wild swing at it but missed completely to find the timber disturbed. Ends the blitzkrieg but he has set the tone with this knock.
Back of a length on middle, Khawaja gets across and whips it through mid-wicket. Won't make the fence but they'll get three more.
Full and outside off, caresses it through the point region for a couple.
Good length angled away outside off, defended firmly off the back foot.
FOUR! More misery for Yasir! Slightly short outside off, Warner crunches it off the back foot past the covers to find another boundary. He is going like a bullet train at the moment.
Floated on middle, worked away to the leg side.
Another half-tracker on middle, pulled away through square leg for a single.
Flatter and short on the stumps, pulled away to the deep on the leg side for a single.
23rd Test fifty for Warner.

SIX! FAB SHOT! The Warner show continues! Floated outside off, in the slot and Warner steps out to carve it away over the covers. Gets it all the way over the fence for a biggie. Second fastest fifty in Test history. He is in the mood to create records, isn't he? Absolute carnage at the moment.
Flatter on middle, Khawaja swivels back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
YASIR SHAH is back on.
Good length closer to off, blocked well from the crease.

FOUR! Four in a row! No stopping Warner. Shortish outside off, Warner stands tall and times the cut beautifully in the gap at backward point. Used the pace well to generate another boundary. Lead is now 276.

FOUR! SLICED! Not in control but it was always in a vacant region. Short of a length outside off, Warner throws his bat at it but gets a thick slice that flies way over the slip cordon as it trickles to the third man fence for a boundary.

FOUR! SHOT! Short of a length outside off, Warner stands tall and punches it through extra cover. Terrific shot and that rockets to the fence for a boundary. Oh, boy! This is some exhibition from Davey! What a start to the New Year for him!
FOUR! CREAMED! Full and outside off, Warner leans into it and times the cover drive beautifully. Lovely stroke and that sped to the fence in no time. Sublime shot.
Full and outside off, leans forward to that one and blocks it well.
Good length outside off, Khawaja lets it pass to the keeper.
Full and outside off, defended firmly off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks solidly.
Good length closer to off, blocked well from the crease.

FOUR! Off the edge! Full and outside off, Khawaja pushes at it with soft hands. Gets the edge that goes between second slip and gully to the fence for a boundary. Streaky runs but the fact that he didn't push hard at it helped him.
Fuller on middle and leg, glanced down to fine leg for a single. Wahab has overstepped as well, no ball called.
Short of a length outside off, Warner goes for a wild pull but doesn't connect as the line is a bit wider.
WAHAB RIAZ comes on to bowl.
Good length angled away outside off, probing line and left alone to the keeper.
Fuller on middle, shuffles across and whips it towards mid on.
Back of a length outside off, well defended off the back foot towards gully.
Full and outside off, crisply driven but straight to cover-point.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends.
Drifting in from middle, Khawaja sits back and pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Darted on the pads, tucked around the corner for a single.
FOUR! WARNER IS ON FIRE! Floated outside off, deft touch from Warner as he employs the reverse sweep. Gets it away very fine towards the deep point fence for another boundary. Huge over this!

FOUR! Slapped! After getting blasted for two maximums, Yasir drops it short outside off. Warner was waiting for it and cuts it through point to find the fence. Just the rollicking start the Aussies would have wanted.

SIX! SMOKED AGAIN! Warner is going to have some fun. It's not like he doesn't usually but this situation gives him more license. Another flighted ball outside off, nails the slog sweep high over long on for a biggie. Got more elevation on this shot to get the maximum result.

SIX! Nailed it! Tossed up outside off, turning in, Warner gets across to that one and nails the slog sweep over wide long on for a maximum. He was looking to launch the leggie in the last over but couldn't quite middle it. Does it this time.
Length ball angling away from well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Short and wide outside off, Khawaja misses out on the offering as he cuts straight towards cover-point.
Fuller and just outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Length ball angled away from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Back of a length on leg stump, Warner gets across to flick but is struck on the thigh pad as the ball rolls to the leg side. The batsmen sneak a leg bye.

NOT OUT! Fuller around leg stump, tails in a bit to rap Warner on the pads as he looks to work it on the leg side. Huge lbw appeal, turned down. Imran coaxes his skipper to take the review. Where did it pitch is the question. Probably pitched outside leg. No inside edge involved but Ball Tracking confirms that the ball indeed landed outside leg which makes the remaining process irrelevant. The on-field call stays.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently towards cover.
Huge appeal! Loopy leg break outside off, spins back sharply to rap Khawaja on the back pad as he plays across the line. Loud lbw appeal but it did too much probably.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Tossed up outside off, Warner goes for the slog sweep but gets an under edge down to fine leg for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, gets across and tickles it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on off, worked with the turn to long on for a single.
YASIR SHAH to share the new ball.
Good length around off, blocked firmly from the crease.
Length ball on middle, raps Warner high on the thigh pad as the batsmen sneak a leg bye.
Just in case you missed the info, Renshaw has been ruled out of the remainder of this game due to concussion. Khawaja is opening the innings with Warner.
Good length on middle, nipping in a bit as Warner bunts it to the off side.
Length ball on leg stump, raps Warner high on the pad as he plays across the line. A bit of inward movement for Imran.
Good length outside off, Warner gets back to push but gets an inside edge on to the pads.

FOUR! Intent straightaway from Warner! Short of a length around off, stays back and plays a fine pick up shot over mid-wicket. Clean strike and it races away to the fence. He's started from where he left off in the first innings.
